mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.summary: The smallest planet and the closest to the Sun.
facts: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
One orbit around the Sun takes about 88 Earth days.

venus.name: Venus
venus.summary: The hottest planet, warmed by its dense atmosphere.
facts: Venus rotates in the direction opposite to most planets.
Its dense atmosphere traps heat, making Venus the hottest planet.

earth.name: Earth
earth.summary: Our home, with vast oceans of liquid water.
facts: Most of Earth's surface is covered by liquid water.
Earth's only natural satellite is the Moon.

mars.name: Mars
mars.summary: Oxidized iron minerals give Mars its reddish color.
facts: Mars looks red because iron minerals have oxidized.
Mars's natural satellites are Phobos and Deimos.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.summary: The largest planet in the Solar System and a gas giant.
facts: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
Its atmosphere shows cloud bands and the Great Red Spot.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.summary: Saturn's rings are made of countless particles of ice and rock.
facts: Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice and rock particles.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.summary: Its extreme axial tilt makes Uranus appear to roll on its side.
facts: Uranus's axis is tilted by nearly 98° from the perpendicular to its orbit.
Uranus has a faint ring system.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.summary: The planet farthest from the Sun in the Solar System.
facts: Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun.
One orbit around the Sun takes about 165 Earth years.
